Compare LOAN with MMDJ letter by letter: L→M (+1), O→M (−2), A→D (+3), N→J (−4).
Rule: alternating forward and backward shifts of 1, 2, 3 and so on.
Apply it to GOLD: G→H, O→M, L→O, D→Z, giving HMOZ.
